frontier.hypothesis: func_80060E38 is closable, and so are the other 28 functions in the tree-wide stride-8 reload-spill class, if and only if the owner elects to rebuild tools/gcc-2.7.2 with a little-endian target triple.
frontier.mechanism: tools/gcc-2.7.2/Makefile:168 (target=mips-mips-gnu) sets BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN == 1, which arms function.c:702-703's bigend_correction = CEIL_ROUND(size,8) - GET_MODE_SIZE(mode) = 4 on every align == -1 reload spill slot. With BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN == 0 the correction is 0 and the slots land at 0,8,...,64 - exactly what the s2 cc1psx counter-exhibit demonstrates from byte-identical input. The existing candidate.c body would then close the function with no further C work, since it already reproduces target's instruction stream, order, register allocation, scheduling and delay slots exactly.
